regions.merged_text: God made me to know Him. 0! What a bless'd aim! To love Him and serve Him sure rests in the same. It's Heaven begun for the grateful on eearth. -- To treasure arigh ! ? ! Highest Heaven its worth. God Himself is the reward even here below ( though only as a shadow, comparatively). But dear Doctor Koch: what I wanted to propose for you is something like this. You have shown quite a little interest in the one great science necessary for real contentment in this world and for supernatural hope in the life awaiting us beyond the
